literalCommands: sqlite3 -header -column cmos/db/cmos.sqlite "SELECT m.id AS mission_id, COUNT(d.id) AS decision_count FROM missions m LEFT JOIN strategic_decisions d ON d.mission_id = m.id AND d.project_id = m.project_id WHERE m.sprint_id = 'sprint-182' AND m.project_id = 'forge' GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY m.id;"
